subject: Branding & publicity language — MSA / Order Form redlines (Bronze AI)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@bronze.ai>, Bronze AI Legal <legal@bronze.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Branding & publicity language — MSA / Order Form redlines (Bronze AI)

Hi Bethany / Bronze legal team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning — excited to move forward. Attached are the current MSA and Order Form redlines from our side (RI_MSA_redline_for_Bronze.docx, OrderForm_Bronze_v2.pdf). Before we route to signatures procurement asked us to confirm two things so we can converge fast:

1) Publicity and press release process: what approvals do you require and what notice period is acceptable for a joint press announcement?
2) Logo/reference rights: are you comfortable with listing Bronze AI on our customer page and including a short case study/callout? If so, what logo usage restrictions should we reference in the Order Form (e.g., small logo permitted vs. full-color primary logo, marketplace badges, co-branded materials)?

We want to avoid open-ended language that prevents routine customer lists and minor marketing mentions, but we also want to respect your approval flow. If you have a redline for the publicity clause, please attach it and we can circulate to our legal team.

Timeline note: your procurement indicated they’d like fully executed contracts by Aug 10 to hit internal go-live — happy to expedite on our side if we can lock the publicity language this week.

Attachments: RI_MSA_redline_for_Bronze.docx, OrderForm_Bronze_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
M: (555) 867-1212
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

--
Redwood Inference — High-performance inference for production LLMs

From: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@bronze.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bronze AI Legal <legal@bronze.ai>, R. Alvarez <ralvarez@procurement.bronze.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Branding & publicity language — MSA / Order Form redlines (Bronze AI)

Karthik — thanks, and appreciate the flexibility.

High level from our side: Bronze is protective of press activity and logo usage. We can agree to being on a customer list and limited co-marketing, but we can’t grant a blanket press release right. Specific asks:

- No public press release naming Bronze without prior written approval from Bronze execs (Marketing + CEO).
- Logo use: Bronze provides a logo package for permitted uses; any use beyond the provided package (e.g., hero placement on a website homepage, use in paid ads, inclusion in third-party marketplaces) requires separate written approval.
- Short product blurbs (<= 50 words) may be used in press kits/customer lists without exec approval but must be pre-approved by Marketing (email ok).

I’ve attached a short redline with the lines we’d like to add to the MSA publicity clause (Bronze_MSA_publicity_redline.docx). We also need a sign-off workflow for approvals; procurement prefers it in the Order Form as an exhibit or a short clause referencing the Bronze approval process.

We’re aiming to keep this simple — we can accept a 30-day review window for press but need the explicit exec approval statement. If you can incorporate these points into your proposed clause we can move to signature.

Thanks,
Bethany Cole
Head of Partnerships | Bronze AI
bethany.cole@bronze.ai

[Attachment: Bronze_MSA_publicity_redline.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Branding & publicity language — MSA / Order Form redlines (Bronze AI)

Team — looping in suggested language and negotiation points. I reviewed Bronze's redline and propose the following compromises to keep customer marketing usable while protecting Bronze:

Proposed MSA publicity clause (suggested text):
"Customer grants Redwood Inference the right to include Customer's name and logo in Redwood's list of customers and marketing materials ("Customer List") and to publish a brief (<= 50 words) product description in press materials, case studies and website content, provided that Redwood obtains Customer's prior written approval for any specific public use. For joint press releases, Redwood will provide Customer with at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice and will not issue the release without Customer's written approval. Customer logos will be used only as provided in Customer's logo usage guidelines; use beyond the supplied guidelines (including paid advertising, third-party marketplaces or prominent hero placement) requires Customer's separate written consent."

For the Order Form I suggest a short addition: "Customer's Marketing Contact and Approval Workflow shall be set forth in Exhibit A (or via a mutually agreed email approval) to allow for a streamlined approval cadence for routine requests."

Implementation notes:
- We should accept the 30-day notice for press.
- Reserve a carve-out allowing Redwood to include Bronze in a standard "customer list" without prior exec approval; that avoids blocking badge placements and partner pages.
- We should also include a confidentiality carve-out for short product blurbs (<= 50 words) so quoting customer is workable for case studies; those still require Marketing approval but can be via email (not exec sign-off).

I have attached a plain-text extract with the clause for insertion (RI_proposed_publicity_clause.txt). If you agree, I can incorporate into the MSA redline and produce a final redline for Bethany to sign off.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: RI_proposed_publicity_clause.txt]

From: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@bronze.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bronze AI Legal <legal@bronze.ai>, R. Alvarez <ralvarez@procurement.bronze.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Branding & publicity language — MSA / Order Form redlines (Bronze AI)

Laura — that language looks reasonable and much closer to what we need. A couple clarifications before we sign:

- Please explicitly exclude "marketplace" badge usage from the default logo permission unless the marketplace use is pre-approved. Bronze lists several marketplace partners where our brand is particularly sensitive.
- For joint press releases we require written approval from both Bronze's Head of Marketing and the CEO (an email thread is sufficient).
- For co-marketing / case studies, Bronze Marketing will aim to respond within five (5) business days to requests marked "routine approval" in accordance with the Order Form exhibit; if the request is substantive it may take longer but Bronze will notify Redwood.

If you can add the marketplace exclusion and the 5-business-day SLA to Exhibit A, we can sign the MSA this week. I’ve attached a short approval workflow for your procurement (Bronze_approval_workflow.pdf) and copied procurement on timelines.

Attachments: Bronze_approval_workflow.pdf

Bethany Cole
Head of Partnerships | Bronze AI

Thanks Bethany — appreciate the quick turn. We’ve incorporated the marketplace exclusion and the 5-business-day SLA into Exhibit A and attached a final MSA redline for signature (MSA_final_redline_for_signature.docx).

Summary of agreed points:
- Customer list: Redwood may include Bronze in customer lists without exec approval.
- Short blurbs (<= 50 words): permitted for case studies/marketing with Marketing approval via email.
- Joint press releases: 30 days' notice + written approval from Bronze Head of Marketing and CEO.
- Logo use: limited to provided logo package; marketplace/paid ads/hero placements require separate approval.
- Exhibit A: includes a 5-business-day SLA for routine approvals and an approval workflow.

Next steps: I’ll route the MSA_final_redline_for_signature.docx to our legal ops for DocuSign and send you the link once routed. If Bronze is good with the final redline we’ll aim to execute by Aug 10 to meet procurement timelines.

DocuSign (prelim): https://docusign.com/r/ox8eKJ-example

Thanks,
Karthik
